account access: The customer cannot get into their account and needs help recovering their username or password, or resetting two-factor authentication.
manage account: The customer asks about services added to or removed from their account, missing credit or account shipping perks, or wants to change profile details.
order issue: The customer asks about or wants to change an existing order: unexpected fees, delivery time, payment method, quantity, shipping speed, or adding and removing items.
product defect: The customer wants to return an item because of a stain, wrong color or wrong size, or wants to start, update or check a refund.
purchase dispute: The customer disputes a purchase: a lower price elsewhere or yesterday, items out of stock, a promo code that fails, or a charge they believe is wrong.
shipping issue: The customer asks about a shipment: its status after a confusing notification, changing its address or item, an item that never arrived, or high shipping cost.
single-item question: The customer has a general FAQ-type question about one clothing product (boots, shirt, jeans or jacket), such as care, sizing, material or stock.
storewide question: The customer has a general FAQ-type question about the store as a whole: pricing of services, timing of events, membership levels, or store policies.
subscription inquiry: The customer asks about their premium subscription: whether it is active, the amount or date due, paying the bill, an extension, or a disputed subscription charge.
site troubleshooting: The customer reports the website not working properly: credit card rejected at checkout, cart not updating, search returning no results, or the site being slow.
recover username: The customer has forgotten or cannot find their username and needs it recovered after verifying their identity.
recover password: The customer cannot log in because they forgot their password and needs a new one generated.
reset two-factor authentication: The customer is locked out by two-factor authentication and needs it reset, with a reset code sent to their email.
unknown service added: The customer believes an unknown or unwanted service was added to their account or plan without their consent.
service wrongly removed: The customer believes an important service was mistakenly removed from their account or plan and wants it back.
account international shipping question: The customer asks whether their account entitles them to free shipping to or from other countries, i.e. international shipping.
account credit missing: The customer says some credit that should be on their account is missing.
change account address: The customer wants to update or correct the address saved on their account profile, not the delivery address of a shipment in progress.
change account name: The customer wants to update or correct the name saved on their account profile.
change account phone number: The customer wants to update or correct the phone number saved on their account profile.
change account payment method: The customer wants to update, add or replace the payment method saved on their account.
unexpected fee on order: The customer believes an extra or unexplained charge was added to their order and wants it explained or removed.
change delivery time: The customer believes the delivery time of their order is wrong and wants to change it, for example from morning to evening, rather than just confirming a date.
wrong order payment method: The customer believes the wrong payment method was used for an order and may want to change it.
wrong order quantity: The customer's order confirmation shows a different quantity than the customer wanted to order.
upgrade to overnight shipping: The customer wants to upgrade an existing order to faster, overnight shipping so it arrives sooner.
downgrade shipping speed: The customer wants to switch an order to slower delivery, such as next week, to save on shipping fees, not to get a refund.
add item to existing order: The customer wants to add another item to an order they have already placed.
remove duplicate item from order: The customer accidentally ordered an extra item, such as two instead of one, and wants the unwanted item removed or cancelled.
start a refund: The customer wants to begin a new refund for an item they purchased and chooses how the money is returned.
add item to existing refund: The customer already has a refund in progress and wants to add another item to that same refund.
refund status: The customer wants to know the status of a refund they already requested, or which payment method it will go to.
return due to stain: The customer wants to return an item because it arrived stained or dirty.
return due to color: The customer wants to return an item because its color is wrong or not what they expected.
return due to size: The customer wants to return an item because it is the wrong size or does not fit.
competitor price lower: The customer complains that a competitor sells the same item for a lower price than they paid.
price was lower yesterday: The customer complains that the item was cheaper yesterday than the price they paid or now see.
items generally out of stock: The customer complains that many items or products in general are out of stock, not one specific item.
one item out of stock: The customer complains that one particular item they want is out of stock.
promo code invalid: The customer's promo code is rejected as invalid when they try to use it.
promo code expired: The customer's promo code is rejected because it is considered out of date or expired.
billed for returned item: The customer was billed for an item they already returned and has not received the credit for it; a billing complaint, not a new refund.
billed for item never bought: The customer sees a charge on their bill for something they never bought in the first place.
shipment status question: After a confusing email notification, the customer asks a yes/no question to check that their shipment is on track.
change shipment details: The customer wants to change something about a shipment in progress, such as the delivery address or the item because they ordered the wrong one.
item never arrived: The customer did not receive an item they ordered and wants to know what happened to it.
shipping cost too high: The customer finds the shipping fee too high and wants it waived or refunded, rather than delaying delivery to save on fees.
boots product question: The customer asks a general question about boots, such as stain or gum removal, width, break-in time, waterproofing, laces, sizes in stock or warranty.
shirt product question: The customer asks a general question about shirts, such as stain removal, washing, arm length, collar width, shrinking, sizes in stock, buttons or material.
jeans product question: The customer asks a general question about jeans, such as stain removal, washing, leg length, tailoring cost, shrinking, colors, sizes or ripped designs.
jacket product question: The customer asks a general question about jackets, such as stain removal, washing or dry cleaning, arm length, detaching the hood, shrinking, stock, material or warmth.
store pricing question: The customer asks a general question about store prices, such as gift wrapping, name stitching, overnight shipping cost, or whether a cart qualifies for free shipping, without changing an order.
membership question: The customer asks a general question about membership: the levels, how to qualify for premium membership, its benefits, or how long it lasts.
store timing question: The customer asks when something happens at the store, such as a new collection drop, store opening hours, the annual sale, or promo code expiry.
store policy question: The customer asks a general question about store policies, such as cancelling a subscription, late subscription payments, refunds or returns, not about their own bill or order.
is subscription active: The customer wants to know whether their payment went through and whether their premium subscription is still active.
subscription amount due: The customer wants to know how much they owe on their premium subscription.
subscription due date: The customer wants to know when their premium subscription payment or monthly renewal is due.
pay subscription bill: The customer wants to pay or renew their premium subscription bill.
subscription payment extension: The customer cannot pay for their premium subscription right now and asks for more time to pay.
dispute subscription bill: The customer thinks their subscription bill is wrong, for example that they were charged twice.
credit card rejected: The customer's credit card keeps being rejected as invalid when they try to pay on the website.
cart not updating: The customer is trying to put an item in their online shopping cart, but the cart does not update.
search not working: The website search keeps showing no results, no matter what the customer searches for.
website too slow: The website has become so slow to load that the customer can barely use it to shop.
